# Standard Contracting Policy Memo

## Template Guidance

Sales teams should prefer a 30-day non-renewal notice period in standard customer templates.

Legal approval is required before accepting uncapped liability for data security incidents.

## Non-Binding Status

This memo is internal template guidance only.

It does not amend, override, or interpret any signed customer agreement unless the Legal team signs a separate amendment.

## Data Policy Preference

The preferred template requires vendors to host regulated customer data in the United States.

This preference is not automatically part of any signed agreement.
